about: Cases that are compared with the mean of several draws of v21's stipple, not one (ADR 0036, proposed; owner's decision of 2026-10-07; ADR 0061 adds the last two): `npm run capture:reference -- --redraws tests/golden/v21-redraws.json` captures draws 1 to N − 1 of each (the capture itself is draw 0).
